discussion_comments.comment_body:
I personally recommend the "early return" style. For example:

```lua
if err then
  return nil, "..."
end

// code in else breach
for k, v in pairs(args) do
//...
end
```

This way we save a level of indentation, and the logic looks more straightforward: except for the error handling, the code does not have branches when doing a list of things in sequence.
